description: Intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) 30-day mortality risk score. Takes clinical variables (GCS, age, hematoma volume in mL, intraventricular hemorrhage, infratentorial origin) as CSV and returns the 0-6 ICH Score, a risk category, and estimated 30-day mortality. Deterministic formula (Hemphill 2001). Can consume hematoma volume/IVH forwarded from a hemorrhage segmentation model.
disease: intracerebral hemorrhage, ICH, hemorrhagic stroke, brain hemorrhage, mortality risk
